nodes.summary: There is an absolute constant $C > 0$ such that for every set $P$ of primes and every real $x > 1$, the number of integers $n$ with $1 \le n \le x$ that are divisible by no prime in $P$ is at most $C x \exp(-A_P(x))$, where $A_P(x) = \sum_{p \in P,\ p \le x} 1/p$.
nodes.title: Pollack–Pomerance sieve bound

nodes.summary: There is an absolute constant $C > 0$ such that for every prime $p$ and every real $x \ge e^p$, the number of integers $n$ with $1 \le n \le x$ for which $p$ does not divide the sum of divisors $\sigma(n)$ is at most $C x (\log \log x / \log x)^{1/(p-1)}$.
nodes.title: Integers whose sum of divisors is not divisible by $p$

nodes.summary: Write $\log_k$ for the $k$-fold iterated natural logarithm, so $\log_3 x = \log \log \log x$, and let $\varphi$ be Euler's totient function and $\sigma$ the sum of divisors. nodes.title: How often $\varphi(\sigma(n)) \ge n / f(n)$

nodes.summary: Write $\log_k$ for the $k$-fold iterated natural logarithm, and let $\varphi$ be Euler's totient function and $\sigma$ the sum of divisors. The number of integers $n$ with $1 \le n \le x$ and $\varphi(\sigma(n)) > n / \log_5 n$ is $O(x \log_5 x / \log_4 x)$ as $x \to \infty$.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
